title: 3-Month Moving Average Revenue
description:
Compute the **3-month moving average** of total monthly order revenue (current month and the 2 preceding months). Round to 2 decimal places.

**Table: orders** — `id`, `customer_id`, `order_date`, `status`, `total_amount`

Output columns: `order_year`, `order_month`, `revenue`, `moving_avg_3m`. The first two months will have NULL for months before the window is full. Order by `order_year`, `order_month`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, status VARCHAR, total_amount DECIMAL); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,1,DATE '2026-01-05','completed',200.00),(2,2,DATE '2026-01-15','completed',100.00),(3,3,DATE '2026-02-10','completed',300.00),(4,4,DATE '2026-02-20','completed',100.00),(5,5,DATE '2026-03-08','completed',500.00),(6,1,DATE '2026-03-25','completed',100.00),(7,2,DATE '2026-04-12','completed',400.00);
solution_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS order_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS order_month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY order_year, order_month) SELECT order_year, order_month, revenue, ROUND(AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_3m FROM monthly ORDER BY order_year, order_month

test_cases.description: Jan avg=300, Feb avg=350, Mar avg=450, Apr avg=466.67

hints: ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW includes the current row plus the 2 before it.
When fewer than 3 rows exist in the window (at the start), AVG computes over the available rows.
